identity.bio: Hands-on product and systems engineer who owns ambiguous problems end to end: discovery, architecture, implementation, release and live operation. Background spans regulated banking platforms, enterprise automation, developer infrastructure, consumer AI products and distributed systems R&D. Creator of cApp and founder/technical lead across ChefSpecials and SocraTech, with a focus on software that remains maintainable, inspectable and useful beyond the prototype stage.
identity.headline: Product, Systems & Automation Engineer · Founder / Principal Engineer building AI-native products and developer infrastructure.
identity.story:
I tend to work where product, systems and engineering boundaries overlap. My strongest work starts with an objective that does not fit neatly inside one team: clarifying the problem, removing dependencies, designing the missing capability and carrying it through implementation, diagnostics and live operation.

I started in platform engineering at Lloyds Banking Group, working across transaction-processing systems, routing, automation and production support in a regulated environment. One of the systems I designed automated creation of virtual Unisys mainframe test environments and saved more than £100,000 annually. I later worked on global business systems at Intertek and product enablement at Learning Pool, where I built automation spanning Product, Engineering, Support and Customer Success, including an AI documentation-intelligence pipeline processing more than 10,000 Confluence and Zendesk documents.

My current work is founder-led product and systems engineering. cApp is a self-hosting web-to-native application framework covering verified packaging, local-first data, native runtimes, Local AI, agents/MCP and GitHub-backed product distribution. ChefSpecials is a complete consumer cooking product and the reference cApp integration. SocraTech focuses on configurable AI agents, persistent memory and auditable workflow automation. I have also built distributed Solana trading and operations infrastructure and service-backed simulation systems.

I use AI aggressively as an engineering multiplier, but not as a substitute for ownership. The parts I care about most are the architecture, security boundaries, failure modes, user journey and whether the thing actually works when it reaches a real environment. I am open to technically ambitious roles, strategic partnerships, licensing conversations and product work where a small amount of strong systems thinking can remove a large amount of complexity.

opportunity.headline: Open to strategic product partnerships, senior systems/product engineering work and licensing conversations.
opportunity.note: Best fit is a technically ambitious product where architecture and user experience need to move together: AI/local-AI products, developer infrastructure, cross-platform delivery, automation, difficult integrations or taking an existing web product into a more capable application runtime. I am open to UK and Middle East opportunities, remote or relocation, and commercial conversations around cApp, ChefSpecials and related platform work.
